_readme: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored: it holds machine paths and your identity. Never commit your real config.json.

identity._comment_did: Your Ed25519 did:key (Technocore identity). The DID's public key IS your FLOP account. Generated via github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat scripts/sign.py keygen — back up the seed separately; it is the airdrop credential.
identity._comment_address: Your FLOP SS58 address, prefix 42. NOTE: FLOP uses the LEGACY SS58PRE personal-parameter encoding, not stock Substrate blake2b-128 — derive it with @flop-labs/cli `keys import/inspect`, never by hand.
identity._comment_keystore: Encrypted Polkadot v3 keystore (official `flop keys import`). The CLI signs with it; the toolkit never touches the seed.

cli._comment: The official @flop-labs CLI. Use CLI >= 0.4.4 + SDK >= 0.5.2 (devnet runtime spec 1014014 breaks older CLI versions).

devnet._comment: Pinned devnet identity (verified 2026-11-10). Devnet earns NOTHING for the airdrop — rehearsal only.

testnet._comment: ARME via `flopkit arm-testnet` only after FLOP publishes the testnet identity. Until pinned, all signing on testnet is refused.

caps._comment: Per-request escrow cap (keep <= the gateway worst-case price of your default model), UTC-day budget, sessions per cycle, subprocess timeouts.

session._comment_excluded: Miners you control — spend to them is not credited demand (independent-demand rule). Add your own miner SS58 addresses here.

watch._comment: Official status surfaces polled by `flopkit watch` (read-only, cron-safe). The machine status page (first entry) is the authoritative live signal.
